claims.text: Gazette Supplement Extraordinary No. 22 of 10 December 2024 prints a proclamation by which Cabinet, exercising section 1(2) of the Foreign Investment Act 2020 (Act 7 of 2020), brings that Act into force on 10 December 2024; it is made at Nuku'alofa that day and signed by Paula Pouvalu Ma'u, Chief Secretary and Secretary to Cabinet.
claims.locator: English column (printed p.90) and Tongan column (printed p.91)
claims.uncertainty: Shows Cabinet exercising a statutory power the day after the resignation. It names no Prime Minister or Acting Prime Minister and is not a caretaker instrument. The Act's content is outside this packet.

scope_note: Listed in the Attorney General's Office 'Gazettes by year' view for 2024 as item 2024-0047 ('GAZ_SE 22/24 10 December 2024 Proclamation'). That listing is selective (its numbering has gaps and it holds mostly legislation), so the absence of a notice from it is not evidence that no Gazette notice exists.
